import os
path='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-837b59b5.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # Find the dominant connected non-background object; isolated singleton marks are
    # placement points for a copy of this object, centered on each mark.
    unseen = set(pts)
    comps = []
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop(); comp={start}; q=[start]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    src = max(comps, key=len)
    sr0=min(r for r,c in src); sr1=max(r for r,c in src)
    sc0=min(c for r,c in src); sc1=max(c for r,c in src)
    shape={(r-sr0,c-sc0,grid[r][c]) for r,c in src}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Single non-background cells outside the source are the markers.
    markers=[next(iter(c)) for c in comps if len(c)==1 and next(iter(c)) not in src]
    mrks=[p for p in markers]
    cr=(sr1-sr0)//2; cc=(sc1-sc0)//2
    for r,c in mrks:
        for dr,dc,v in shape:
            rr=r+dr-cr; co=c+dc-cc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=co<w: out[rr][co]=v
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(code)
print(path)
